## Cookie.getExpiryDebugInfo() method

Returns human-readable diagnostic information about how this cookie's expiry was derived (raw `Expires`<!-- -->/`Max-Age` attributes, their parsed values, response-`Date`<!-- -->-based clock skew, the attribute that ultimately won, and any invalid attributes that were dropped), or `undefined` when expiry diagnostics were not requested when the cookie was parsed or stored.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getExpiryDebugInfo(): ExpiryDebugInfo | undefined;
```
**Returns:**

[ExpiryDebugInfo](./tough-cookie.expirydebuginfo.md) \| undefined

## Remarks

- The returned object is plain JSON-serializable data; all times are absolute (epoch milliseconds plus a UTC ISO string), so it is timezone-independent and safe to log.

- The information is descriptive only. It is never included in cookie headers, [Cookie.toString()](./tough-cookie.cookie.tostring.md)<!-- -->, or [Cookie.toJSON()](./tough-cookie.cookie.tojson.md)<!-- -->, and it does not affect storage or matching.

Enable it via the `expiryDebug` option of [Cookie.parse()](./tough-cookie.cookie.parse.md) or `CookieJar.setCookie`<!-- -->.
